_note: BUNDLED DEFAULT for the prfaq-prototype plugin. Swappable prototype build targets: the prototype-builder agent and the sandbox-scaffolder / sandbox-composer skills READ this file — they never hardcode a playground. To point at YOUR playground WITHOUT editing the installed plugin, copy this file to `prototype-targets.json` (or `.claude/prototype-targets.json`) in your project and edit `workspace_relative_root`; the pipeline prefers a project copy over this bundled default. Add a newer playground by adding an entry and flipping `active_default` — no agent or skill edit required.

proto-playground.label: proto-playground — Compass UI (current default)

companion_repos.name: compass-design
companion_repos.why: the playground links the unpublished @mattermost/compass-proto package from ../compass-design (file: dependency); it also holds the compass-ui and compass-proto component source. Must stay the SIBLING of workspace_relative_root — if you move the root, move this path with it

scene_api.center_slot: setCenterSlot(<SceneSwitcher/>) inside a useEffect; cleanup setCenterSlot(null); re-run on active-scene change; never position:fixed the control
scene_api.scene_register_note: Not in mattermost-proto-playground main. If a later playground adds useRegisterPrototypeScene (or similar), use it so reviewer comments scope per scene; otherwise skip — never phantom-import it.

base_layouts._note: Prefer composing each scene ON TOP of one of these REAL app surfaces (runtime-verify the names; shells come from @mattermost/compass-proto, admin panels from @mattermost/compass-ui). Resolution priority: (1) reuse an existing prototype that already assembles the surface, (2) compose from these shell/layout components, (3) if the surface isn't covered, ask the human for a screenshot to build on top of, (4) else build freeform and flag it. Never hand-roll a frame when a real base layout or reference prototype exists.

proto-playground.reference_dir: prototype-runs/<slug>/reference/  (human-provided screenshots of surfaces to build on top of; optional, non-blocking)
proto-playground.styling: SCSS Modules, full BEM single-root, tokens from src/styles/tokens.scss — no hardcoded hex/px/ms; @mattermost/compass-icons; Open Sans (body) / Metropolis (headings)
proto-playground.base_path: / locally; /mattermost-proto-playground/ only when built in GitHub Actions
proto-playground.dev_note: Needs ../compass-design next to the playground (companion_repos). predev/prebuild/prepreview run scripts/ensure-compass-packages.mjs, which checks the npm compass-ui install and builds compass-proto dist in compass-design when stale. Use npm run build for validation and npm run preview for screenshots.
proto-playground.reviewer_comments: Only when the playground provides a scene-registration hook (see scene_api.scene_register_note); mattermost-proto-playground main has none.

vercel.gated: explicit user request only — deploying is an external publish and must be confirmed per Output Rules

proto-playground.multi_option_convention: One prototype slug per PRFAQ run. Each design OPTION is a scene-set the reviewer flips between via SceneSwitcher in the center slot (option chips), so options compare side-by-side under one URL and per-scene comments scope cleanly. Only when options diverge so structurally that a shared shell misleads, fall back to sibling manifest entries <slug>-option-a / <slug>-option-b.
proto-playground.starter_note: No starter folder in the playground; follow .cursor/skills/scaffold-prototype/SKILL.md and mirror example_prototype.
